# PDF.js

The PDF import uses the locally bundled PDF.js 4.10.38 release from Mozilla.
The library and worker are kept local so PDF text extraction does not depend on
a third-party runtime CDN. PDF.js is licensed under Apache License 2.0; see
[LICENSE](./LICENSE).

Upstream release: <https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/releases/tag/v4.10.38>
